description: Single-quarter income for one credit union: net income, interest income, interest expense, noninterest income and noninterest expense per quarter (dollars), 2018-03 to the latest quarter. Give cu_number and either one quarter (default latest) or a start-end range. Derived by this project from consecutive year-to-date 5300 call reports (Q1 equals the reported year-to-date). Every row carries a continuity_status checked against NCUA's certified merger and conversion history: rows starting 'verified' are plain values; 'event_contaminated' rows span a merger, purchase-and-assumption or conversion and carry the event date, type and counterpart institution; 'unverified_no_adjacent_prior' rows return null values with the reason. One credit union per call; no rankings or trailing totals here. Use find_credit_union to look up a cu_number.
name: cu_quarter_income
